facts.text: For a bounded technical laboratory, register stock items with exact-string unique SKU and read/list operations. SKU normalization is explicitly out of scope.
Accept bounded positive stock debits only by inserting an immutable, uniquely identified journal entry and decrementing available units atomically without overselling. This is not a sale or payment.
Reverse a posted debit once, credit its exact units atomically and record an auditable state transition. Repeated reversals must not credit stock twice.
Provide an unauthenticated health readiness endpoint; inventory data and mutations require distinct capabilities.
Customer sales, prices, taxes, payment settlement, physical stocktaking and refund policies are not specified in this prototype.

knownQuestions.question: What normalization and equivalence policy should apply to SKUs in a future business implementation?
Who can exercise real inventory write/read permissions in production, beyond the isolated test identities?
What sale cancellation, refund and inventory reconciliation policies should the future business application support?
